Added: Mythos 5.2 (claude-mythos-5-2) is a choice for reviews (Settings → Model for reviews and the review model picker), and its usage is priced at $8 in, $40 out and $0.20 cache read per million tokens, the same as Fable 5.2. It is for organizations verified by Anthropic; other accounts get an error from the API. Fable 5.2, Fable 5.1 and the others stay selectable.

whats_new.title: Mythos 5.2 for reviews
whats_new.text: You can now pick Mythos 5.2 as the model for reviews. It is only available to organizations Anthropic has verified, so if your account does not have access, pick another model. Fable 5.2 and the rest are still there.
